paper_metadata.title: A 2.7-V 1.8-GHz Fourth-Order Tunable LC Bandpass Filter Based on Emulation of Magnetically Coupled Resonators
paper_metadata.abstract: A low-voltage fourth-order RF bandpass filter structure based on emulation of two magnetically coupled resonators is presented. A unique feature of the proposed architecture is using electric coupling to emulate the effect of the coupled inductors, thus providing bandwidth tuning with small passband ripple. Each resonator is built using on-chip spiral inductors and accumulation-mode pMOS capacitors to provide center frequency tuning. The filter has been implemented in HP 0.5m CMOS process and occupies an area of 0.15 mm2. It consumes 16 mA from a single 2.7-V supply at a center frequency of 1.84 GHz and a bandwidth of 80 MHz while providing a passband gain of 9 dB and more than Fig. 1.
